title: H$^2$EDL: Hyper Evidential Deep Learning for Hierarchical Classification
abstract: arXiv:2608.18185v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Fine-grained recognition often involves hierarchical label spaces, where a model may be confident about a coarse semantic concept while remaining uncertain among its descendant classes. Such structured ambiguity requires uncertainty representations that capture both fine-grained classes and intermediate concepts. However, existing tools each capture only half of it: flat evidential classifiers quantify total ignorance with a single vacuity on the leaf frame, and hierarchical classifiers propagate point probabilities with no notion of evidence. Hyper-opinions would unify the two, but their general form is exponential in the label count, and existing hyper-evidential networks either require composite labels to be supplied in the training data or read them off an unstructured weight pattern, with no principled notion of which composites deserve mass. translated_title: H$^2$EDL：用于层次分类的超验证据深度学习
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.18185v1 公告类型：新 摘要：细粒度识别通常涉及层次标签空间，其中模型可能对某个粗粒度语义概念有信心，同时在其子类之间保持不确定性。这种结构化歧义需要能够同时捕捉细粒度类别和中间概念的不确定性表示。然而，现有工具各自只捕捉了其中一半：平坦证据分类器通过叶框架上的单一空置来量化总无知，而层次分类器传播点概率且没有证据概念。超意见本可以统一两者，但其一般形式随标签数量呈指数增长，现有超证据网络要么要求训练数据中提供复合标签，要么从非结构化权重模式中读取它们，没有关于哪些复合体应获得质量的原则性概念。我们观察到，分类法本身是缺失的超域。其子树和叶单例...
tldr: 本文提出H$^2$EDL方法，利用分类法结构作为超域，统一了层次分类中的证据不确定性和细粒度类别表示，有效解决了结构化歧义问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes H$^2$EDL, which leverages taxonomy structure as the hyperdomain to unify evidential uncertainty and fine-grained class representation in hierarchical classification, addressing structured ambiguity effectively.
